subject: Post-call: Luminex trial sprint plan & credentials needed
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@luminex.io>, Priya Rao <priya@luminex.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial sprint plan

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap and suggested next steps so we all have the same runway for the trial. High-level notes from discovery: Luminex wants to evaluate Redwood for document summarization and QA over internal support transcripts, with latency SLOs of <250ms p50 and sensitivity around PI redaction. Key internal stakeholders: Amit (product), Priya (security), and network-admin (infrastructure).

POC objective (4 weeks):
- Success criteria: 1) Summaries within F1 score >= baseline (we'll define exact eval set), 2) Avg token cost below $0.012/token for evaluation workload, 3) Reliable end-to-end pipeline (SSO + allowlist + keys) with <1% error rate for inference calls.
- Scope: sandbox dataset (10k transcripts), API integration for batch + streaming, and eval scripts for quality/regression.
- Timeline proposal: week 0 = infra setup (SSO + IP allowlist + API keys), week 1 = ingest + initial runs, week 2 = tuning and quantization trials, week 3 = end-to-end eval and wrap-up.
- Owners: Redwood: Ben (ops lead) and Marissa (CS / eval owner). Luminex: Amit (product owner) and Priya (security sign-off).

Immediate asks for Luminex to unblock week 0:
1) Add redwood@redwood.com to your Okta tenant (SAML SP) or send identity metadata for SSO setup. We will provide an SP metadata file.
2) Provide a short list of IP CIDRs to allow for sandbox traffic (or confirm we'll use mutual TLS if preferred). We attached a network-allowlist-template.csv to make this easy.
3) Confirm who should receive sandbox API keys and the preferred provisioning method (email vs secure portal).
4) If you need it for procurement/legal, we attached a draft POC SOW (POC-SOW-v1.pdf).

Ben will follow up with technical connection details and sample API key flow. If these look good, can we target getting SSO invite + initial allowlist by EOD 2027-06-25?

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
km: (510) 555-0192
Attachments: POC-SOW-v1.pdf (application/pdf), network-allowlist-template.csv (text/csv)
From: Amit Shah <amit@luminex.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@luminex.io>, network-admin@luminex.io
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial sprint plan

Thanks Kim — good summary. We like the proposed scope and timeline. A few clarifying items from our side:

- For SSO: we use Okta. Please send the SP metadata and the list of attributes you require (email, name, groups). Also confirm whether we should create a dedicated Okta application for Redwood or add Redwood to an existing one.
- IP allowlist: our infra team prefers nothing on the public allowlist; we will provide a set of outbound NAT CIDRs you can accept. network-admin@luminex.io is looped in to share the exact list.
- API keys: security would prefer keys be provisioned after IP allowlist is accepted and SSO test users are set up. Temporary dev keys with scoped rate limits are fine.
- Legal: we'll have a short review for the POC SOW; expect comments by Wed 2027-06-23.

We will aim to have the allowlist to you tomorrow and a first set of SSO test users by Thursday. One ask: can Redwood provide an example SAML metadata URL and a short checklist for Okta configuration?

Appreciate the clear owners — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Product, Luminex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@luminex.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@luminex.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial sprint plan

Hi Amit — looping in the technical details you'll need.

Quick answers and what we'll do next:
- SAML metadata: we host an SP metadata endpoint and can share a one-click bundle. URL (example): https://saml.redwood.com/sp/metadata/luminex. I'll send the real metadata file in a separate secure message. Required attributes: email (NameID), givenName, familyName, and groups (optional).
- API key flow: We only issue sandbox keys after the allowlist check is complete. Provisioning steps: 1) Luminex provide CIDR list; 2) We authorize CIDRs on the sandbox; 3) We create scoped API key tied to project LUM-2026-023; 4) We email key to list (or push to secure vault).
- Sample network-allowlist-template.csv is attached for your infra team (contains columns: cidr, region, purpose).

Technical notes on limits for the sandbox: default token limit is 2048 tokens per request; rate limit for POC keys will start at 10 requests/sec with burst to 50 and can be adjusted. If you'd like streaming enabled, tell us which endpoints you plan to hit so we can pre-warm routes.

I'll also add a short checklist for your Okta admin to our shared Drive folder. If everything looks good, I'll provision a temp key the same day we confirm the CIDRs.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: network-allowlist-template.csv (text/csv)
From: Priya Rao <priya@luminex.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@luminex.io>, network-admin@luminex.io
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial sprint plan

Thanks everyone. Quick confirmation from security: we'll provision the outbound NAT CIDRs to your team by EOD 2027-06-22 (network-admin already has the template). We'll also create three Okta test users (product+sec+infra) and share identity metadata early morning 2027-06-25 so you can attempt the SSO connection on Thursday.

On the SOW, legal will put comments into the Drive doc by Wed as Amit noted. After Ben confirms the SAML metadata URL and the provisioning flow, we'll be ready for the sandbox key issuance.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Security, Luminex
